description: This Java class 'ReadableImage' represents an entity for image data within the web catalog module. It extends a base entity class and implements Serializable, providing getters and setters for image name and URL.

classes.name: ReadableImage
classes.description: A class representing an image with a name and URL in the web catalog, extending Entity and serializable for persistence and transfer.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image.

methods.name: getImageName
methods.description: Returns the name of the image.

methods.name: setImageUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the image.

methods.name: getImageUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the image.
